decisions.briefing: Markets are risk-on today with NASDAQ and S&P 500 both up 1.7%. We added DUOL and OUST, the two candidates with the strongest multi-signal confirmation, leaving one slot open rather than forcing a third buy. All existing positions are held unchanged.

market_education.summary_en: Broad indices rallied together today, with both NASDAQ and S&P 500 gaining 1.7%, suggesting a general risk-on shift across sectors rather than a single catalyst. Momentum names with bullish technical setups, like DUOL and OUST, led the screener with multiple confirming signals including MACD crossovers and volume surges. This breadth of strength supports deploying some of the idle cash into high-conviction names rather than staying defensive.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日大盤齊漲，納斯達克與標普500指數同步上升1.7%，顯示市場整體轉向風險偏好，而非單一消息面刺激所致。動能股如DUOL及OUST在篩選榜上表現突出，同時出現MACD黃金交叉及成交量放大等多重訊號確認。市場廣泛走強，支持將部分閒置現金投入高信心標的，而非維持保守觀望。

daily_lesson.explanation_en: A MACD crossover happens when a stock's momentum line (MACD) moves above its signal line, often signaling that upward price momentum is building. Combined with other confirming signals like rising RSI and volume surges, it gives traders more confidence that a rally has real strength behind it, not just a random spike.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: MACD黃金交叉是指股票的動量線（MACD）向上穿越訊號線，通常代表上升動能正在增強。若同時配合RSI上升及成交量放大等其他訊號確認，投資者便更有信心判斷這波上漲具備實質動能，而非單純的隨機波動。
